posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Silverleaf:

I'm glad the names are more interesting than that. I've always thought that something like "The Bat" sounds better than Batman.And why is a Spider-Man hyphenated when Batman isn't?

Don't know if you are referencing it, but Bob Kane based Batman on the Villain of a 1930 remake (The Bat Whispers) of a 1926 movie based on a 1920 Broadway play (both The Bat).

The story is a house with hidden treasure, a bunch of searchers, detectives and a caped murderer known as "The Bat".

The 1926 film includes ziplines with flowing cape, the cape flourishes and a great shot of him spreading his cape out infront of the full moon making what would later become the Bat-Signal.

I actually know this from being a silent film nut, I don't even like Batman.  The Bat was a much better character.  Power creep ruined Batman.
